7212.title: Injected Claude skills depend on privileged directory symlinks
7212.rootCauseOneLine: Both injected-skill link paths request directory symlinks; injected EPERM drops plugin assembly or rejects partial duplicate filtering before its catch.
7212.proposedFix: Validate an unprivileged Windows directory-link strategy at both sites, including absolute paths and repeated junction setup, then demonstrate native failing-before/passing-after evidence.
7212.caveats: Two clean Linux fault-injection runs, not native Windows or live Claude sessions. No PR: the native-platform reproduction gate remains unmet.
